meta.name: multi-agent-meeting
meta.description: 项目管理专家与产品经理在做项目决策、技术评审或商业策略制定时，当需要多视角碰撞以打破思维局限，请用此技能模拟多智能体真实会议辩论，一键生成包含决策结论、核心论据与风险提示的完整会议记录，让复杂决策高效落地！

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 模拟多方辩论，一键产出含结论与风险的会议纪要
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你常陷于单视角决策，需要多方观点碰撞来拍板。
copy.tagline_en: Generate decision-ready meeting notes from a multi-perspective debate.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want multi-perspective input before finalizing a project decision.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会模拟多个不同专业背景的 AI 智能体开会，就你给出的议题发言、辩论并收敛，最后产出一份含决策结论、关键论据、风险提示和后续行动的会议记录。
howto.when: 当你需要多角度分析问题、不同领域专业知识的碰撞，或模拟团队决策讨论时触发。

say.text: 模拟一场技术架构评审会，讨论是否采用微服务架构
say.note: 会输出各角色发言与决策记录

say.text: 组织产品定价策略会议，设产品经理、市场分析师、财务顾问角色
say.note: 给出定价方案对比与风险提示

say.text: 开一场项目风险评估会，列出风险清单和应对措施
say.note: 输出风险清单、影响评估与建议

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude simulates a meeting of several AI agents with different backgrounds and personalities to debate your topic, and outputs a meeting record with the decision, key arguments, risk notes and next actions.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you need multi-perspective analysis, input from different professional fields, or a simulated team decision discussion.

say_en.text: Simulate a technical architecture review on adopting microservices
say_en.note: Produces agent statements and a decision record.

say_en.text: Run a product pricing strategy meeting with PM, marketing and finance roles
say_en.note: Compares pricing options with expected returns.

say_en.text: Hold a project risk assessment meeting and list risks and responses
say_en.note: Outputs a risk list with impact levels and actions.
